name: hanviet-learn-chinese
description: 汉越学堂 — Laravel full-stack monolith

scripts.setup: composer install && php artisan key:generate --force && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan db:seed --force && php artisan app:enrich-vietnamese && php artisan app:publish-frontend
scripts.data:all: npm run data:vocab && npm run data:lessons
scripts.data:seed: php artisan db:seed --class=JsonDataSeeder --force && php artisan cache:clear
scripts.data:pipeline: npm run data:all && npm run data:seed
scripts.build: php artisan app:publish-frontend && php artisan config:cache
scripts.test: php artisan test && bash scripts/test-api.sh http://127.0.0.1:8000
